method: Visual inspection of original chapter JPEGs and enlarged contextual crops for every detector-only text/SFX candidate emitted by the three-model fusion at RT score >=0.35 and COO score >=0.4.
scope: Four detector-only candidates over 45 pages; subjective visual judgments, not a labeled corpus or a pixel-accuracy estimate.

candidates.evidence: Rocks and debris at the bottom of the page; no visible lettering.
Thin bottom-edge sliver of a blank white speech-balloon border.
Floating debris and short action/ink marks over white space, no glyph.
Two light rock/debris shapes over dark ground, no writing.
